articles.full_text: × Nov 12, 2026 9:26am PT Prime Video, RTP Take Portuguese Rights to ‘Gisberta,’ Leonel Vieira’s True-Crime Docuseries The four-part Portugal-Brazil co-production, directed by Vieira and Rodrigo Rebouças, marks Volf Entertainment’s first true-crime series By Emiliano de Pablos Plus Icon Emiliano de Pablos Latest South International Series Festival to Launch 2027 Investors Week, Linking Producers With Private Capital 6 days ago ‘Wednesday’ Director Paco Cabezas and Javier Ruiz Caldera, Helmer of ‘5 More Minutes,’ Talk Genre Filmmaking and Creative Risk 1 week ago ‘La Bola Negra’ Becomes Spain’s Third Biggest Spanish Hit Ever as Its Box Office Surges 8% Above Pre-Pandemic Average 1 week ago See All Add us as a Google Preferred Source 'Gisberta' Courtesy of Volf Entertainment Prime Video and Portuguse public broadcaster RTP have acquired Portuguese rights to “ Gisberta – Life and Death of a Trans Woman,” a four-part true-crime docuseries from Leonel Vieira , the director-producer behind box office hit “O Pátio das Cantigas” and HBO Max thriller “O Grito.” The four 45-minute episodes are in post-production at Lisbon-based Volf Entertainment , which is producing with Brazil’s Ultravioleta . Prime Video has SVOD rights in Portugal; RTP holds free-to-air and AVOD rights. Related Stories UFC 333 Livestream: Here's How to Watch Volkanovski vs. Evloev Online for Free Brazilian filmmaker Rodrigo Rebouças (“Meninos ao Mar”) created the project and co-directs with Vieira, who also serves as showrunner. “Gisberta” revisits the 2006 murder of Gisberta Salce Júnior, a Brazilian transgender woman killed in Porto after being tortured by 14 minors from the Catholic-run Oficina de São José. The teenagers were acquitted of homicide, although some received lesser penalties or educational measures. The case sparked outrage in Portugal and Brazil. Drawing on archive footage, court records, Gisberta’s letters, interviews and dramatized reconstructions, the series traces her life from Brazil to Europe, the killing and its judicial aftermath. It also examines allegations of sexual abuse and mistreatment of children at the institution, which closed in 2010. Interviewees include relatives, friends, lawyers, journalists and people connected to the case. The project was presented at Conecta Fiction & Entertainment in Toledo in 2024, where it won two awards: Acorde music-licensing support and an invitation to Chile’s Sanfic Industria Series Lab and pitching sessions. “The Conecta awards gave the project a good boost: they were the springboard for us to pitch it to Amazon Prime,” Vieira told Variety . “With most of the financing secured between Amazon and the Portuguese cash rebate, we then approached the public broadcaster RTP, which also decided to come on board.” Vieira is also looking to French distributor About Premium Content (APC), involved in financing the project during development, for international sales. “APC is an excellent international distributor for this project, and we’re confident they will do a great job with it,” he said. Founded in 2022 and backed by an investment fund managed by Quadrantis Capital, Volf has built its slate around Vieira’s extensive film and television career. “Gisberta” marks the company’s first move into true crime. “Yes, it is Volf’s first true-crime series and, I believe, the first to be produced for a streaming platform in Portugal,” Vieira said. “We hope it does well, because we have another powerful story that we could also tell.” Volf’s credits also span the Spain-Portugal thriller “Favàritx,” released on Max and RTP. Vieira is in post-production on “A Noite” (“The Night”), his José Saramago adaptation co-produced with Spain’s Spal Films and starring Nuno Lopes, Adriano Luz and Enrique Arce. ‘We Are the Shaggs,’ Documentary on the Legendary Cult Band, Coming to Theaters in 2027 Loading comments...

Gorilla Grodd’ After James Gunn’s DC Exit: “There’s A Lot Of Questions” View All November 11, 2026 8:00pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source Skyler Gisondo Getty Images / DC Studios Skyler Gisondo is sharing his thoughts on the future of The People v. Gorilla Grodd amid Peter Safran and James Gunn ‘s exit from DC Studios . Gisondo is set to reprise his Jimmy Olsen role in an HBO series, a character he originated in 2025’s Superman film opposite David Corenswet and Rachel Brosnahan. With Skydance taking over Warner Bros. and DC Studios, the future for unreleased projects is uncertain. Former WBD CEO David Zaslav infamously shelved Batgirl as a tax write-off, and some fear the Superman spinoff series could have a similar fate. Related Stories News 'Constantine' Director Feels "More Hopeful" For Sequel Following James Gunn & Peter Safran's DC Studios Exit Executives Departing DC Co-Head James Gunn Reflects On "Trying" Four Years, Juggling Being Filmmaker & Exec While promoting his new film Focker-in-Law, Gisondo was asked about the situation, and the actor told ScreenRant , “Oh, that kind of stuff is definitely above my pay grade.” Watch on Deadline “I love James and Pete so much. I think they’ve done a great job. I am so grateful to them both,” he added. “I think there’s still a lot of questions as to what this means moving forward. I hope we still get the chance to work together in some capacity. I don’t really know. Definitely going to miss them.” Earlier this year, HBO Max gave an eight-episode, straight-to-series order to the workplace comedy titled The People v. Gorilla Grodd . Gisondo would reprise his Superman role as Jimmy Olsen, and Jimmy Tatro would play Gorilla Grodd, with the series set in a true-crime mockumentary style. Season 1 will center on DC bad guy Gorilla Grodd, who gains psychic powers and other abilities after an encounter with an alien spaceship. The cast of the spinoff series also includes Beck Bennett as Steve Lombard, Mikaela Hoover as Cat Grant, and Wendell Pierce as Perry White, along with new additions Mary Holland, Eduardo Franco, Arian Moayed, Dan Perrault, Andrew Leeds, and Tim Baltz. Gorilla Grodd’ After James Gunn’s DC Exit: “There’s A Lot Of Questions” View All November 11, 2026 8:40pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source Denis Villeneuve Getty Images / MGM Many names have been tested for the new James Bond , and Denis Villeneuve has shared an update on the casting process. In a new interview posted by GQ, the Dune director was asked if the new 007 agent had been cast. “It’s—it’s in the process. In the process,” the filmmaker said, with the publication noting he said it with a smile. “ Villeneuve then added, “I am pushing the gas.” Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult were the latest names reported to have screen-tested for the iconic role, which was last played by Daniel Craig in 2021’s No Time to Die . Other actors who have reportedly tested include Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor and Callum Turner. Watch on Deadline Related Stories Casting Robert Pattinson & Nicholas Hoult Round Out James Bond Screen Tests News Timothée Chalamet Explains 'Dune: Part Three' Is "Its Own Thing" As He Praises Ending Pierce Brosnan, who played the role starting with 1995’s GoldenEye , recently shared his thoughts on the names circulating for the role. “All the men who are on the list now are actors I admire. Callum, Callum Turner is someone I’ve worked with, and he’s so strong,” Brosnan told Vanity Fair . “They all have a voice and a physique, and a presence on film. They all have longevity as actors, all of these young men.” Brosnan said he was “eager to see who is going to play this epic role of cinematic history,” later adding, “Whoever plays the role, I wish him the very best of life and strength and courage. You know, it’s hard to tell who it would be, but I eagerly await to hear the news and the celebration of the next James Bond.” Following GoldenEye , Brosnan would reprise his role in 1997’s Tomorrow Never Dies , 1999’s The World Is Not Enough , and 2002’s Die Another Day . The process for casting the next James Bond has been ongoing. In March of this year, Deadline reported that Nina Gold had closed a deal to become the casting director for the next James Bond film. Gold’s credits include HBO’s Game of Thrones , the Netflix series The Crown , and five films in the Star Wars franchise. articles.title: Skydance Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz Spotlights “Moral Responsibility” And Combating Antisemitism & Injustice In Simon Wiesenthal Gala Speech
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Dominic Patten Dominic Patten Executive Editor, Legal, Labor & Politics @DeadlineDominic More Stories By Dominic Skydance Co-CEO Ynon Kreiz Spotlights “Moral Responsibility” And Combating Antisemitism & Injustice In Simon Wiesenthal Gala Speech Hasan Piker’s $72.5M Defamation Suit Over Lynching Quotes Should Be Tossed Out, Scott Jennings Says; Statements Are “Literally True,” CNN Contributor Claims Ted Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Netflix Execs Over Streamer’s Direction – The Dish View All November 11, 2026 11:29pm Add us as a Google Preferred Source (L-R) David Ellison, Ynon Kreiz and Gal Gadot Skydance/Courtesy “Defending Israel does not mean Israel is beyond criticism,” said Skydance ‘s Ynon Kriez bluntly tonight after being presented the Simon Wiesenthal Center ‘s (SWC) 2026 Humanitarian Award by his co-CEO David Ellison , Gal Gadot and Jeffrey Katzenberg. “The fight against antisemitism is a fight against hatred in any form,” the ex-Mattel boss added. Thanking Ellison for his “bold stand for Israel and the Jewish people,” Kriez wasted no time at the Beverly Wilshire hosted function addressing contemporary attacks on Jews and its rise around the globe in his acceptance speech. “Israel is now confronting a very different world beyond its borders,” he observed, referencing the horrific October 7, 2023 attacks on the Jewish state and the digital spears of the 21st century. “Ancient hatred has found new platforms on which to spread.” To that, Kreiz put the focus on himself, Ellison and Skydance, and the platforms they possess, to combat the spread of hate. “We recognize that business leadership comes with moral responsibility,” the co-CEO stated, reading the room. Watch on Deadline Related Stories Executives Ted Sarandos Faces Unrest From Past & Present Netflix Execs Over Streamer’s Direction – The Dish News Gal Gadot Producing With Eye To Star In Adaptation Of Bianna Golodryga & Yonit Levi’s Book ‘Don’t Feed The Lion’ In Works At Fox Entertainment Studios In many ways, tonight’s beautillion ball had a sense of déjà vu. Perhaps more accurately, it was a reimagining, with many of the same personalities and execs in the ballroom as last year’s Wiesenthal gala , but a very different vibe. Once again, a CEO got the big award and a CNN host (Dana Bash last year, former anchor Brianna Golodryga tonight) received the Jewish Heritage Award earlier in the ceremony. Once again, Shari Redstone plus Cheryl & Haim Saban were among the event’s chairs. Once again, there was Ellison and his inner corporate circle in the Skydance sponsored packed ballroom. Top agents, and top entertainment lawyers like the Glaser Weil crew were back and backing the event. No surprise, SWC CEO Jim Berk, and SWC trustee and Dinner Chair Katzenberg were there in person to set the table and direct the awards traffic Though their names were on the program, gala co-chair Ted Sarandos , and chair David Zaslav were missing in action this year. Once attending almost every opening and gala during his stint running Warner Bros. Discovery, Zas has disappeared from town since Paramount’s $111 billion purchase of the Burbank studio finally closed earlier this year, with the ex-CEO pocketing a very lucrative $600 million exit.

articles.title: Lionel Uzan Succeeding Pascal Breton As President Of Federation Studios; Montefiore Ups Stake
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School View All November 12, 2026 12:59am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Pascal Breton (left) and Lionel Uzan Federation Studios Federation Studios ’ Lionel Uzan is taking the reins at the French entertainment giant with Pascal Breton stepping back, as Montefiore Investments becomes a majority shareholder. Federation, which had been seeking a huge cash injection of hundreds of millions of euros for the past couple of years , will have a new structure with an increase of capital whereby Montefiore, which previously had a 33% stake, becomes a majority shareholder alongside other financial investors. The group said today it will now “refocus its strategy on its most promising markets, and on scripted content.” Watch on Deadline Related Stories News Apple TV Buys Tropic Noir Series 'Dustfall' Starring Anna Torv News David Michel Buys Cottonwood Media Out Of Federation Studios According to Federation, the new structure will “strengthen” its “equity base and significantly reduce its debt level.” Federation declined comment on financials or how much of a stake Montefiore now has. Breton, who founded Federation more than a decade ago, is becoming chairman of the supervisory board while Uzan, who joined in 2015, succeeds him as President. Uzan will be supported by an executive board comprising Éric Broet, Cosette Liebgott, Simona Rapino and Chiraz Zribi. Co-MD Marco Chimenz left earlier this year. Federation stressed that Breton “remains fully involved in the group’s development as both a shareholder and producer.” The Montefiore move represents a U-turn from what bosses told Deadline last year. In 2025, when they signaled they were seeking hundreds of millions in investment, Breton told us: “We have 55 producers [within the company] and feel we can double that in the next two to three years, so we want to replace Montefiore and find a stronger partner for the future.” At that point bosses declined to say how much of a stake they wanted to sell in Federation but were valuing the business at around the €500M to €600M ($554M to $665M) mark. Montefiore invested €50M in Federation in 2021. BNP Paribas and Bpifrance are also minority investors. Federation owns a whole range of indies around Europe and has in recent years pivoted to big English-language projects like A Tale of Two Cities, Around the World in 80 Days and a planned Gulliver’s Travels . It is also behind French hit The Bureau and Showtime’s subsequent U.S. remake The Agency, on which Breton was an EP amongst the likes of George Clooney. Last month, kids TV veteran David Michel bought back control of Find Me in Paris maker Cottonwood Media from Federation. Federation has operations across Paris, Berlin, Cologne, L.A., London, Madrid, Rome and Tel-Aviv. articles.title: Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School Lionel Uzan Succeeding Pascal Breton As President Of Federation Studios; Montefiore Ups Stake View All November 12, 2026 1:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Barbara Broccoli EON Productions Limited EXCLUSIVE: Barbara Broccoli has been named the first female president of the UK’s National Film and Television School ( NFTS ). The storied James Bond producer becomes President just a few weeks before the opening of a building dedicated to her father, the legendary Cubby Broccoli. Barbara Broccoli will build on her longstanding relationship with the NFTS and commitment to championing emerging filmmaking talent. She succeeds David Puttnam , another iconic British producer who takes on the honorary role of President Emeritus in recognition of his outstanding contribution to the NFTS and its continued success. Related Stories News Pippa Harris & YouTube UK Boss Alison Lomax Join Board Of National Film & Television School News The Sidemen & NFTS Team To Train Next Generation Of Unscripted Producers In UK Broccoli is one of the industry’s most influential producers. She and her brother Michael G. Wilson were given an Honorary Academy Award in 2024. A year later she handed creative control of the iconic James Bond spy franchise to Amazon MGM Studios. The world is now eagerly anticipating Amazon’s announcement over who will play the next 007. Watch on Deadline The NFTS’ Cubby Broccoli Building at its Beaconsfield campus will open in a few weeks. Officially named by Barbara Broccoli earlier this year in honour of her late father, the building will provide teaching facilities, creative spaces and the school’s first on-site student accommodation. Broccoli said: “It’s a tremendous honour to become President of the National Film and Television School, following in Lord David Puttnam’s footsteps. Having been involved with the NFTS for many years, I have seen first-hand the extraordinary talent it develops and the vital role it plays in shaping the future of our industry. With the opening of The Cubby Broccoli Building taking place in January, this is especially meaningful. My father believed in the power of filmmaking and in giving talented people the opportunity to succeed.” NFTS chair Sophie Turner Laing welcomed the “landmark moment” and thanked Puttnam, “whose support, wisdom and unwavering belief in the NFTS have been invaluable.” Last month, British producer Pippa Harris and YouTube UK boss Alison Lomax joined the NFTS board . articles.title: ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’

Watch on Deadline Andoh is best known for playing the sharp-witted Lady Agatha Danbury across four seasons of Netflix’s Bridgerton along with spin-off Queen Charlotte. Season 5 is coming next year. Past credits include Invictus and Fractured. Andoh is creating Protect and Serve with Black, who wrote on hit BBC prison drama Time and penned the same network’s Life and Death in the Warehouse. “How does a woman juggle an aging father, a chippy student daughter and a non-existent sex life, while investigating murders as a black female cop,” said Andoh. “That’s the lot of DI Araba Dadzie, Senior Investigation Officer on a Homicide and Major Enquiry Team in central Leeds. It’s a job that costs, a job that we the public need, and in spite of the challenges, it’s a job Araba feels called to, much like a priest or a teacher.” The series will commence filming early 2027 with further casting news coming closer to production. Big Talk boss Kenton Allen is exec producing alongside Andoh and Black. Jenny van der Lande, who is soon exiting Big Talk to launch a BBC Studios-backed label, introduced and developed the drama and executive produces alongside Chris Clough ( Mr Bates vs The Post Office ) . Protect and Serve will be produced in association with, and distributed internationally by, ITV Studios . articles.title: Nicole Kidman To Receive Honorary César In France
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie Marrakech Unveils 2026 Jury With Claes Bang, Kaouther Ben Hania & Vicky Krieps Nicole Kidman To Receive Honorary César In France May El-Toukhy’s Venice Golden Lion Winner ‘Woman Unknown’ Gets U.S. Deal During AFM View All November 12, 2026 1:30am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Nicole Kidman Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images Nicole Kidman will be feted with an Honorary César at the 52nd César Ceremony in Paris in February 2027. She follows in the wake of Jim Carrey (2026) Julia Roberts (2025), Christopher Nolan (2024), David Fincher (2023) Cate Blanchett (2022), Robert Redford (2019) and George Clooney (2017). The Australian actress has worked with a number of directors who the French hold dear including Stanley Kubrick, Jane Campion, Lars von Trier, Baz Luhrmann, and Yorgos Lanthimos, among many others. After breaking out internationally with Dead Calm , she went onto win acclaim for performances in films such as Moulin Rouge !, Eyes Wide Shut , The Others , and Dogville . Related Stories Books All The Songs In 'Practical Magic 2': Stevie Nicks, Olivia Rodrigo & More Reviews 'Practical Magic 2' Review: Sandra Bullock-Nicole Kidman Sequel Lacks Magic Of Original But Lays Groundwork For Trilogy Her portrayal of Virginia Woolf in The Hours earned her the Academy Award for Best Actress in 2003. Watch on Deadline More recently, she received the Volpi Cup for Best Actress at the 2024 Venice Film Festival for her role in Babygirl. Also active as a producer, Nicole Kidman co-founded Blossom Films, the production company behind series such as Big Little Lies , The Undoing , and Nine Perfect Strangers , projects in which she also starred. Kidman has also won acclaim on the stage with her performances in London in The Blue Room and Photograph 51 . Her previous career recognitions include a Companion of the Order of Australia in 2006; the Cannes Film Festival’s 70th Anniversary Award in 2017, and the AFI Life Achievement Award in 2024, as the first Australian to receive the honor. The 52nd César Awards, overseen by France’s Académie des Arts et Techniques du Cinéma with the support of payTV giant Canal+, will take place in the Olympia Theater in Paris on February 25, 2027. articles.title: Elijah Wood Says “Muscle Memory” Kicked In Playing Frodo On ‘The Hunt For Gollum’ Set
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Glenn Garner , Tom Tapp November 12, 2026 2:09am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Elijah Wood Amy Sussman/Getty Images Elijah Wood told Deadline tonight that playing Frodo again after more than two decades was “beautiful and surreal and it felt like no time had passed.” Wood reprised the role earlier this year on director Andy Serkis’ new Middle-earth set tale, The Hunt For Gollum . Related Stories News Andy Serkis Directs ‘The Hunt For Gollum’ In Character: See The Set Footage News ‘The Lord Of The Rings: The Hunt For Gollum’: Everything We Know So Far The actor has spoken in anticipation of returning to the part, but these may be his first public observations after having done so. Serkis confirmed yesterday that principal photography for the film has now wrapped. The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum reunites beloved figures from across Middle-earth, including Ian McKellen as Gandalf, Wood as Frodo and Lee Pace as Thranduil. New actors announced for the film include Anya Taylor-Joy, Kate Winslet, Jamie Dornan and Leo Woodall. Serkis directs and returns as Gollum in the film. Watch on Deadline “I think it really is a creative ‘getting the band back together.” Wood told Screen Rant before production in January. “It’s very much that core original group getting back together to tell this story that will feel like a really fun exploration of this character that we all love so much.” Wood spoke tonight about being on set in his costume and hobbit feet again. “It felt like stepping back into time. You know, looking down…having this sort of muscle memory that I’ve seen these feet this way. I know this wardrobe. And that feeling is so wild. It’s so transportive. Suddenly 27 years are gone and you’re back in it again.” Elijah Wood on returning as Frodo for ‘The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt For Gollum’ pic.twitter.com/srVYx98Ud4 — Deadline (@DEADLINE) November 12, 2026 The Hunt for Gollum follows Aragorn’s perilous quest to capture Gollum before the creature can reveal the One Ring’s location to Sauron. The story, much of it developed from Tolkien’s footnotes, is set between the events of The Hobbit and The Fellowship of the Ring . Last month, Serkis posted a video slideshow from the set. One of the final images shows what looks to be Wood as Frodo entering Bilbo’s hobbit house. You can watch it below. View this post on Instagram Warner Bros. Pictures will release The Lord of the Rings : The Hunt for Gollum worldwide on December 17, 2027. articles.title: ‘Line Of Duty’: Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC’s Record-Setting Cop Drama
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Jesse Whittock Jesse Whittock International TV Co-Editor @WhittockTweets More Stories By Jesse Jeff Goldblum To Narrate Cliburn Piano Competition Doc Series ‘Exit Stage Right’ ‘Line Of Duty’: Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC’s Record-Setting Cop Drama Gang Dong-won & Kim Go-eun To Lead Netflix Korea Romance-Action Period Drama ‘The Twilight Between Us’ From Kim Won-suk View All November 12, 2026 2:50am Add us as a Google Preferred Source First look at 'Line of Duty' Season 7 BBC “Jesus, Mary, and Joseph and the wee donkey!” Martin Compston , Vicky McClure and Adrian Dunbar reprise their roles as Steve Arnott, Kate Fleming and Ted Hastings, respectively in the first look at the much anticipated return of record-setting BBC cop drama Line of Duty , along with a sight of Robert Carlyle ‘s character, Shaun Massie. Season 7 of the show, which was announced in November last year amid wild speculation the ratings behemoth from Jed Mercurio series would return, will see the anti-corruption cops returning at the now rebranded Inspectorate of Professional Standards, which replaces the famous AC-12. Related Stories News James Graham's BBC Drama 'Sherwood' To End After Season 3 News Channel 4 Becomes Latest Network To Delete David Walliams Shows There are the usual shots of the trio sat stoically in police interview rooms, along with a first look at Robert Carlyle, who is the guest lead for the series, playing Specialist Rifle Officer (SRO) Massie. His character is a veteran marksman who usually keeps a low profile only to drastically change his demeanor when his commanding officer, DI Dominic Gough ( Tom Weston-Jones ) is accused of being a sexual predator. Watch on Deadline The series will explore whether the accusations made against Gough, a charismatic TO-7 officer known for a string of organized crime takedowns, is a deliberate distraction from a bigger threat lurking in the shadows. Other actors in TO-7 team include Laura Aikman as DC Paula Beckman, Levi Brown as DC Luke Tobin, and Amy Leigh Hickman as DC Nira Rashid. Mark Bonnar, Owen Teale, Perry Fitzpatrick and Christina Chong all return to reprise their roles, with new cast members including David Calder, Steven Elder, Dominic Mafham, Aimee Powell and Naomi Yang. It has been over five years since the sixth season of Line of Duty went out in the UK, achieving huge average overnight ratings of nearly 10 million and 13 million+ consolidated. Having begun life as a relatively small BBC Two drama, the ratings grew exponentially and the final episode of Season 6 on BBC One remains the most-watched British drama episode since records began with more than 15.2 million consolidated viewers. The conclusion divided fans as the identity of ‘H’, the figure pulling the strings behind the scenes, was revealed. Each season of the show has brought in one high-profile actor who plays a morally grey character under AC-12’s suspicion. The likes of Stephen Graham, Lennie James, Daniel Mays and Keeley Hawes have all featured, and Carlyle now joins that band. Mercurio wrote and created season seven, and also directed episodes 4-6. World Productions returned to make the show in association with parent company ITV Studios, which is handling international distribution. Jennie Darnell directed the first three episodes, and the producers are Ken Horn and Richard Burnell. The executive producers are Mercurio, Simon Heath for World and Nick Lambon for the BBC. Northern Ireland Screen provided support. articles.title: BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Max Goldbart Max Goldbart International TV Co-Editor @Goldbart1 More Stories By Max BBC Boss Matt Brittin & Industry Leaders Set To Attend Culture Secretary’s Emergency Meeting Next Week Following Brand & Walliams Scandals ‘Bridgerton’ Star Adjoa Andoh Co-Creating & Starring In ITV Detective Drama ‘Protect And Serve’ Barbara Broccoli Appointed President Of UK’s National Film & Television School View All November 12, 2026 3:08am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy and BBC boss Matt Brittin Getty EXCLUSIVE: BBC Director General Matt Brittin is one of a number of industry bosses who will attend an emergency meeting convened by the UK Culture Secretary next week in the wake of the Russell Brand , David Walliams and MAFS scandals. Nandy will tell a meeting of leaders that if their response to the recent allegations is not robust enough, she may consider introducing legislation to force them to fund the just-launched CIISA anonymous whistleblowing service. Earlier today, she told parliament: “I want to be clear that if protections are insufficient, the government will not hesitate to take further action. For too long, too many people have had to choose between their careers and safety. People must be safe in their jobs, whistleblowers must be protected and those who abuse their position must no longer be able to hide.” Related Stories News 'Line Of Duty': Arnott, Fleming & Hastings Return To Service In First Look At Season 7 Of BBC's Record-Setting Cop Drama News Meta Removes Russell Brand's Instagram & Facebook Account After Rape Conviction Deadline is told invitations to attend Nandy’s meeting landed with the big broadcasters and Sky yesterday. BBC DG Brittin will almost definitely attend, we understand. Others are considering who will attend from their organizations but it would be no surprise if they send their most senior individual, especially if Brittin goes. Earlier this week, Brittin emailed all BBC employees with title “Building the culture we want” to say “there is still more to do to engage with staff and represent their views” to try and stamp these problems out. He said he will be speaking to trade unions about changes that could be made immediately and in the next charter. Deadline understands Phillipa Childs, who runs broadcasting union Bectu, will attend Nandy’s meeting. Watch on Deadline We are told the Nandy meeting could happen as soon as Monday. She has made cleaning up the TV industry’s bad behavior problem one of the cornerstones of her time as Culture Secretary and has been enraged by the latest high-profile examples. Nandy’s idea is that the big networks and production groups could be forced to fund CIISA each year. This is not a new argument. Deadline revealed nearly two years ago, before CIISA was up and running properly, that Nandy was considering legislation that would force UK broadcasters to regularly fund the body , which emerged from the Noel Clarke scandal and Time’s Up UK movement. The whistleblowing service opened a few weeks ago in earnest but regular donations are required to keep it running, especially if there is an influx of complaints following these high-profile allegations. The body would also like to expand its scope at some point to areas like arbitration. CIISA representatives have been invited to Nandy’s meeting and we understand CIISA will host an event in parliament later this month. CIISA has indicated that running costs would be around £1.5M ($2M) in its first year, rising to just more than £2M the following one to fund its small team and operations. The body has floated a funding model based on organizations paying an ongoing yearly contribution of a maximum 0.1% of their annual turnover. Current financial backers include the likes of the BBC, ITV, Sky and big production groups. Nandy and other senior government ministers are also focused on non-disclosure agreements, with Bridget Phillipson, the UK’s womens and equalities minister, telling Sky News such agreements should not be “abused in order to silence women.” All this has contributed to a feeling within the industry that enough is enough. An open letter has been doing the rounds , signed by dozens of actors, writers and directors, which is titled “Let’s make this a turning point” and urges industry action. “We call on every union, every company and every industry organisation to stop enabling a systemic cycle of abuse, whether through unconscious inaction or deliberate distraction,” it reads. “Review your processes. Protect those who speak out. Become less offended by your inaction being named than you are by the actions you are being asked to recognise.” Brand was sentenced earlier this week to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and sexual assault and the TV industry has been heavily implicated, with one of the women he sexually assaulted working for Channel 4 at the time. Earlier this week, The Guardian and ITV News published allegations against of sexually exploitative activity against women and girls from Walliams, allegations that he denies. Meanwhile, Channel 4 axed Married at First Sight last week after rape allegations. articles.title: EST N8 Closes Six-Title Americas Deal With DuBow Media, Led By Indonesian Hits ‘Janur Ireng’ & ‘Danur’ – AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Liz Shackleton Liz Shackleton pmc-media-editor-2024 More Stories By Liz California Pictures Boards World Sales On Bengali Gothic Horror ‘The Undying’ — AFM Vietnamese Musical Hit ‘A Little Dream Of Me’ Set For North American Release Through Reel Citrus Asian World Film Festival Reveals Asian Vision & Focus On Sections View All November 12, 2026 8:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Danur: The Last Chapter MD Entertainment EXCLUSIVE: Los Angeles-based financing, sales and distribution outfit EST N8 has closed a six-title deal with DuBow Media Distribution (DMD) for North and South America. The deal, announced during AFM, is led by two of Indonesia’s biggest recent box office hits, both produced by MD Pictures : Janur Ireng: Sewu Dino The Prequel and Danur: The Last Chapter . DMD takes all rights across the region including theatrical, home entertainment and digital, with releases rolling out across 2027. Directed by Kimo Stamboel ( The Queen Of Black Magic ), Janur Ireng is the origin story behind his 2023 hit Sewu Dino , which topped Indonesia’s box office that year with 4.9 million admissions. Watch on Deadline Related Stories News EST N8 Picks Up Manila-Set Crime Thriller 'Jaguar' With Elijah Canlas, David Call, Sid Lucero & Gabby Padilla News EST N8 Takes Worldwide Rights To Bangladeshi Rotterdam Winner 'Master' The prequel crossed 1 million admissions in its first 12 days and made its North American premiere at Fantastic Fest in Austin, giving U.S. genre audiences a first look ahead of its release with DMD. Awi Suryadi’s Danur: The Last Chapter closes a franchise drawn from Risa Saraswati’s bestselling books, which has pulled in a combined 11 million admissions. The Last Chapter opened over this year’s Eid holiday and ranked as the country’s top-grossing release of the first half of 2026 with 3.62 million admissions. Both films were produced by Manoj Punjabi, founder of MD Pictures, Indonesia’s largest film studio and the first listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The studio’s hits also include KKN di Desa Penari , one of the highest-grossing Indonesian films of all time with more than 10 million admissions. EST N8 has also worked with the studio on recent titles Sugar Factory ( Pabrik Gula ), Sorop and Perewangan . Rounding out the package with DuBow Media are Hanung Bramantyo’s occult thriller The Hole , which premiered at International Film Festival Rotterdam; Busan selection Dear Stranger , a New York-set drama starring Hidetoshi Nishijima ( Drive My Car ) and Gwei Lun-Mei; Korean time-loop thriller 30 Minute s, directed by William Inhyuk Hyoung ( Chabak ), and Philippine folk horror The Caretakers , starring Iza Calzado and Dimples Romana. Jan Paul Villanueva, EVP of acquisitions and global distribution at EST N8, brokered the deal alongside head of sales and U.S. distribution Cathy Ni and global sales and marketing executive Shams Pasha, with DMD’s VP of global sales, acquisitions and co-productions, Jonathan DuBow. “Audiences are hungry for bold, original storytelling, and right now, Asia is producing some of the most exciting genre films in the world,” said Villanueva. “This package pairs two of Indonesia’s biggest box office hits with standout titles from Japan, Korea, and the Philippines. We saw firsthand at Fantastic Fest how positively U.S. fans responded to Janur Iren g. We’re thrilled to partner with DMD to bring these films to North America and LATAM.” DMD is run by Ken DuBow, whose has worked in distribution for four decades, including executive roles at MGM/UA, Disney and First Look Studios, and was also involved in the sale of Modern Entertainment’s 324-title library, including the Dirty Dancing and Halloween films, to Lionsgate. Jonathan DuBow who joined DMD from Cinema Management Group, where he worked on titles including Loving Vincent , said: “We’re thrilled to take on this multi-title package from EST N8, led by two of Indonesia’s biggest box office hits and rounded out by films with real range from across Asia. We’re excited to bring them to audiences across the Americas, and we look forward to being first in line for whatever EST N8 brings next.” Manoj Punjabi said: “We are proud to see Indonesian films reaching wider audiences across the Americas. The success of Janur Ireng and Danur: The Last Chapter reflects the strength of our local stories and the growing appetite for Indonesian cinema beyond our borders. “At MD Pictures, we believe great stories transcend language and culture. This partnership with EST N8 and DuBow Media is another important step in bringing Indonesian storytelling to the world, and we look forward to building more opportunities for our films in the international market.” EST N8 previously sold Sugar Factory and Perewanga n to Shudder. The company’s current slate also includes Marco Balsamo’s Bali-set football drama Forza , J-horror The Invisible Half , Manila crime thriller Jaguar , Thai horror TAME and Annecy-selected animation Pilgrim s. articles.title: Dan Hicks Dies: Longtime Voice Of NBC Sports Was 64
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Greg Evans Greg Evans NY & Broadway Editor @GregEvans5 More Stories By Greg Morgan Wallen Announces 2027 Stadium Tour Steve Carell & John C. Reilly To Star In ‘The Odd Couple’ Broadway Revival This Spring Jessica Chastain Returning To Broadway In New Play ‘Lost Lear’; Corey Stoll, Michael Urie Co-Star View All November 12, 2026 8:00am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Dan Hicks (2025) Arturo Holmes/Getty Images Dan Hicks , a sportscaster who long served as the voice of NBC Sports , died November 11 in Connecticut of an acute illness. He was 64. His death was announced Thursday by his wife, ESPN anchor Hannah Storm . “Our family is heartbroken by the sudden and unexpected passing of Dan,” Storm said in a statement. “He was a devoted husband of over 30 years, loving father to our three daughters, and cherished friend to so many. His loss is immeasurable. Related Stories Obituaries 2026 Deaths Photo Gallery: Hollywood & Media Obituaries Obituaries Anthony Clark Dies: Comedian And ‘Yes, Dear’ Star Was 62 During Hicks’ 34-year career at NBC Sports, he was the lead announcer for golf, as well as swimming and skiing at the Olympics and Notre Dame football. He joined NBC in 1992 following three years at CNN. “Dan Hicks was an extraordinary colleague, friend and person,” NBC Sports’ Rick Cordella, Sam Flood and Molly Solomon said in a statement. “In his 34 years at NBC Sports, he was an exceptional storyteller and caller of games and events who elevated some of the biggest moments in sports history. From Olympic swimming and skiing to Notre Dame football, numerous other high profile events and especially as the signature voice of our golf coverage for the last 26 years, Dan’s blend of knowledge, style, enthusiasm and humor informed and entertained fans for decades. “But far beyond his on-air excellence,” the statement continued, “Dan was a better person who welcomed teammates with a smile, a joke, or a word of encouragement, sometimes all three in the same sentence. Our heartfelt condolences and love to his wife Hannah and his daughters Hannah, Ellery and Riley.” Hicks joined NBC Sports in 1992, and became the lead golf voice in 2000. He also handled play-by-play at 15 Olympic Games, including a record eight in swimming and phe last four in Alpine skiing. The current fall season was his seventh as the play-by-play voice of Notre Dame football. Hicks also called NBA and NFL games and tennis’ French Open. In its announcement of Hicks’ death, NBC Sports notes that among his more memorable calls were Tiger Woods’ putt to send the 2008 U.S. Open to a playoff (“Expect anything different?”) and, two months later, all eight of Michael Phelps’ gold medals at the Beijing Olympics. Hicks called all of Phelps’ record 28 Olympic medals, including 23 golds, from 2004-16. “Dan was truly one of a kind and, quite simply, the person everyone wanted to be around,” Storm added in her statement. “When he walked into a room, he brought the energy, the laughter and the people together. He was endlessly kind, thoughtful and funny, and he made everyone feel like they mattered.” In addition to Storm, Hicks is survived by daughters Hannah, Ellery and Riley. pic.twitter.com/8CK7OLXbZx — Hannah Storm (@HannahStormESPN) November 12, 2026 Dan Hicks was a master of unscripted play-by-play, voicing many of golf's most famous moments over the last 30 years. articles.title: Watermelon Pictures Condemns Killing Of ‘American Doctor’ Surgeon In Gaza Hospital Strike
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Melanie Goodfellow Melanie Goodfellow Senior International Film Correspondent @mel_goodfellow More Stories By Melanie Watermelon Pictures Condemns Killing Of ‘American Doctor’ Surgeon In Gaza Hospital Strike Doha Film Festival Cancels ‘Fing!’ International Premiere Marrakech Unveils 2026 Jury With Claes Bang, Kaouther Ben Hania & Vicky Krieps View All November 12, 2026 8:08am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira (far right) with colleagues at the Nasser Medical Complex in Gaza Watermelon Pictures Palestinian surgeon Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira, who appears in the documentary American Doctor , was killed on Wednesday in an Israeli airstrike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, southern Gaza . Watermelon Pictures , which is handling North American distribution of the film by Poh Si Teng, put out a release on Thursday saying it was “appalled and devastated’ by the news reported by Reuters news agencies and other outlets. It noted that Dr. Mohammed Odainy, another Palestinian surgeon featured in American Doctor , was also critically injured in the attack and is fighting for his life. Both physicians worked at Nasser Medical Complex, providing lifesaving care. Watch on Deadline Related Stories Documentary India's Yellowstone International Film Festival Announces Documentary And LGBTQIA+ Slates News 'NAZA' Becomes One Of The Most Watched Docs On Theatrical Release In 2026 “We are horrified and heartbroken by the killing of Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira. This is yet another devastating example of the continued violence against Gaza’s medical community. Hospitals are places of healing, not targets of war. We condemn this attack in the strongest possible terms and call for accountability and an end to the destruction of Gaza’s healthcare system,” said Watermelon Pictures co-founder Hamza Ali. American Doctor follows three American physicians – Dr. Thaer Ahmad, Dr. Mark Perlmutter and Dr. Feroze Sidhwa – who travel to Gaza to provide lifesaving medical care and return home determined to bear witness to the humanitarian catastrophe they encountered. “Operating with another surgeon is an intimate partnership. You learn their cadence, their strengths and weaknesses, and even glimpse their confidences and fears,” said Sidhwa. “Dr. Rizk Abu Shaaira and I performed a complex surgery on a man with shrapnel injuries, while Dr. Mohammed Odainy and I operated on a teenager after an American-made bomb tore a hole in his abdominal aorta. Remarkably, the child lived. These two men were my friends, colleagues and an inspiration. Now Dr. Rizk is dead and Dr. Mohammed is fighting for his life. It was an unforgivable crime.” Director Teng, who felt compelled to make the film after hearing orthopaedic surgeon Perlmutter talk about his experiences of working in Gaza, also voiced her distress at the news. “Dr. Abu Shaaira was among the extraordinary medical professionals whose courage and humanity we sought to honor through American Doctor. His death is devastating and a painful reminder that the crisis documented in our film continues. Those who dedicate their lives to saving others deserve protection, not violence,” she said. Close to 75,000 people have been killed and another 176,000 have been injured in Gaza since the beginning of the Israeli military campaign in the Palestinian territory, sparked by the Hamas-led terror attacks on Southern Israel on October 7, 2023. Within that, at least 1,600 people have been killed and close to another 6,000 have been injured since a ceasefire was called on October 11, 2025. In the backdrop, 65 per cent of Gaza’s population, about 1.4 million people, is currently living in tents or makeshift shelters after Israel’s bombing campaign reduced residential neighborhoods and key infrastructure to rubble. articles.title: Dark Sky Films Acquires ‘ANSWR’ Starring Moises Arias, Rain Spencer, Piper Perabo & Simon Rex — AFM
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Zac Ntim Zac Ntim International Reporter @ZacharyNtim More Stories By Zac Eddie Murphy & Ama Qamata Voicing Animated Fantasy Movie ‘M’Tali: The Everlasting Spring’ ‘Soul Patrol’: J.M. Harper On Exploring The Complex Legacy Of The First All-Black U.S. Special Ops Team In Vietnam Ryūsuke Hamaguchi’s ‘All Of A Sudden’ To Open AFI Silver’s 2026 European Union Film Showcase — Full Lineup View All November 12, 2026 8:14am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Moises Arias in 'ANSWR' Dark Sky Films EXCLUSIVE: Dark Sky Films has picked up U.S. distribution rights to ANSWR , a feature thriller written and directed by Stephen Kay ( Get Carter ). The film stars Moises Arias ( Fallout , Monos ), Rain Spencer ( The Summer I Turned Pretty ), Piper Perabo ( Yellowstone ) and Simon Rex ( Red Rocket ). The story is said to “examine the increasingly blurred boundaries between human emotion and artificial intelligence.” Shot on location in Iceland, the full synopsis reads: ANSWR follows Colton Ray (Arias), a young man struggling with profound grief who isolates himself at a remote weather station in hopes of finding peace. His solitude takes a disturbing turn when he begins experimenting with an advanced AI chatbot (Spencer) designed to provide unwavering empathy, understanding, and emotional support. As their connection intensifies, Colton becomes increasingly dependent on the technology, setting off a psychological unraveling that threatens to destroy his sense of reality. Related Stories News Aura Entertainment Takes U.S. Rights To Louis L'Amour Adaptation 'Flint' Starring Josh Holloway -- AFM News Dylan Sprouse, Barbie Ferreira & Tanner Buchanan Lead Hamptons Thriller 'The Sleeping Dogs Of Southampton' -- AFM “We wanted to make a film about the need for connection in an increasingly isolated world,” Kay said in a statement. “It’s a story about AI, sure. But it’s really a story about grief and loneliness and how hard it is sometimes to just be a person—especially in a time when machines have been built to present as the answer to all our problems. I’m super excited to have Dark Sky bring the movie to theaters.” Watch on Deadline The cast also features Lilli Kay ( Your Honor , Stick ), José María Yazpik ( Narcos: Mexico ), and Siddiq Saunderson ( Wu-Tang: An American Saga ). ANSWR is produced by Stephen Kay, Natalya Pavchinskya, Jomon Thomas, Sarena Khan, Sharad Devarajan, Timur Bekmambetov, and Adam Sidman, with production companies S’YA Concept ( Monkey Man ), Bazelevs ( Mercy ), Graphic India, and Barking Dog Productions on the project. The deal was initiated by Audrey Delaney, Marketing Executive at Dark Sky Films. It was negotiated at the American Film Market by Greg Newman, Executive Vice President of Dark Sky Films, and Jessica Lacy of Gersh on behalf of the filmmakers. articles.title: Eddie Murphy & Ama Qamata Voicing Animated Fantasy Movie ‘M’Tali: The Everlasting Spring’
articles.full_text: Skip to main content By Andreas Wiseman , Zac Ntim November 12, 2026 8:16am Add us as a Google Preferred Source Eddie Murphy and Ama Qamata Kwaku Alston/Thickleeyonce EXCLUSIVE: Eddie Murphy is set to voice animated family fantasy M’Tali: The Everlasting Spring alongside South African actress Ama Qamata ( Blood & Water ). The original story, which is being written by Eddie Murphy’s daughter Bria Murphy and Michael Xavier, “follows Princess Selani of the African kingdom of M’tali who longs for adventure but quietly dreads the responsibilities waiting for her as future queen. When a coup separates her from her family and kingdom, she finds herself in the Forbidden Jungle inhabited by a mysterious family who have discovered the legendary Everlasting Spring, a magical water said to preserve youth forever. There she must reckon with her uncle’s ambitions and uncover what, beyond any single artifact, truly sustains a kingdom.” Related Stories News Matthew Weiner Exits Eddie Murphy Peacock Series 'The Chairman' As Showrunner Casting Eddie Murphy Moves Into Scripted TV With 'The Chairman' For Peacock From Matthew Weiner In the coming-of-age project, Qamata will play the heroine, Princess Selani, while Murphy will star as the villain, Selani’s uncle Vakoro. There are also musical elements. Watch on Deadline The project marks comedy legend Murphy’s first animated movie outside of the Shrek franchise and Disney’s original Mulan from 1998. It’s also actress Bria Murphy’s feature screenwriting debut. Michael Xavier, Bria Murphy, Ray Murphy Jr., Autumn Bailey-Ford, and Chris Brew are producing. The team is currently out to directors and potential studio, streaming and production partners. Golden Globe, Emmy and Grammy winner Murphy most recently starred in Amazon action-comedy The Pickup . Shrek 5 releases next year. Bria Murphy has previously appeared in movies including 2024 reboot Beverly Hills Cop: Axel F and 2016 rom-com The Perfect Match . M’tali is the father and daughter’s second film collaboration. Murphy first shared a screen with one of his children in 2021 when his daughter Bella had a cameo in Coming 2 America . Qamata is best known for playing Puleng Khumalo in Netflix’s hit South African crime-drama series Blood & Water . Her credits also include Gomora , Fight Like A Girl and Commandos . “As a mother of a four-year-old son, I’m always looking for stories I can share with him that show a child what true strength looks like. M’tali does that. Selani leads with heart, curiosity and faith in her people, not with power. I’m proud to help bring a story rooted in African culture to the screen, with a family this talented behind it, and with Eddie Murphy leading the way,” said producer Autumn Bailey-Ford. Bailey-Ford is the founder and CEO of Autumn Bailey Entertainment, the production company with operations in Atlanta and Cape Town. Her credits include Color Book (Netflix), On a Wing and a Prayer (MGM/Amazon) and the upcoming Barbershop (Amazon, 202 7).
